items:
Welcome to our Gulf Coast Retreat, a luxurious oasis nestled in Inlet Beach, Florida. Just steps from the Gulf Coast's pristine shores, our home provides modern comforts with coastal charm and tasteful decor, perfect for unwinding after a day of beach side adventures.

Nature lovers will delight in Camp Helen State Park's scenic trails and coastal landscapes, with the sound of waves as your soundtrack.

Whether you're seeking adventure or relaxation, we are looking forward to hosting you.

Our home is mere minutes from the Inlet Beach Public Beach Access, restaurants, shopping, spas, nature trails, state parks, kayaking, surfing, wildlife watching, and more. What's more, the house itself is a destination with custom interior design, spacious bedrooms, a luxurious soaking tub, and a theater room with tiered seating, an 80" TV, and surround sound!

The open concept ground floor has soaring 12ft ceilings, hand-painted murals evoking local nature, an enormous 9ft sectional with a double wide chaise, arm chairs and ample seating for all guests, 58" smart TV on a swivel mount, a bespoke dining table, chef's kitchen complete with all the appliances and cooking/baking supplies you could want, a gas range in the kitchen island to create your very own hibachi style cooking experience, and is full of original art. You'll also find an adorable half bath, a screened porch (no need to worry about bugs) with an outdoor sectional, gas grill, ceiling fan to keep the breeze going, a dining table that expands to seat 10, and the most amazing outdoor lighting for when it gets dark (you'll be sending pictures of that one to your friends for sure!). The final space on the ground floor is the theater room. You'll have tiered seating with double daybeds, which can also be used for sleeping, on the top tier and another 9ft sofa on the bottom level.

On the second floor, you'll find a designated office space, a beautiful full bath with walk in shower and double vanity, the gorgeous flamingo room with a luxury pillow top queen bed, 40" smart TV, and a private balcony that overlooks local sand pines and scrub oak in the neighborhood. You'll also find the bunk room that is a riot of color with two bunk beds. One twin over twin, and one twin over full, the full is a futon fold-out. The laundry room is fully equipped with both a full sized washer and dryer, drying rack, hanging rods and hangers, and an iron and ironing board. Lastly, the principle bedroom is a study in modern beauty. The custom oak headboard lights from behind for the most relaxing golden glow in the evenings. There is also a 50" smart tv, dual closets, a dresser, a lounge chair, and an en-suite bathroom with double vanity, walk in glass shower with a standard shower head and ceiling mounted rain shower head, an enormous soaking tub, and separate water closet.

Pets are allowed but we ask to keep them off the furniture. We ask that you don't use our linens to clean your pets. Please clean up thoroughly if your pet has a mess. Non-refundable pet fee applies.

The community has a swimming pool available for guests. Access code provided.

Feel free to drop a chat whenever you are in need, we will respond as soon as possible while you enjoy your stay with us. Thank you.

Heading to the easternmost end of 30A allows visitors to travel back in time to a day when Florida`s natural environment remained untouched. Inlet Beach sets itself apart from other areas of South Walton because of its emphasis on preserving the natural splendor of Florida while creating a vacation experience unlike any other. Deemed the oasis of "Old Florida," Inlet Beach marries the organic beauty of white sand beaches and coastal dunes with eco-friendly modern amenities and sustainable architecture.

Need to make special arrangements for a memorable stay, help with restaurant reservations, or arrange a beach party? We have concierge services - just ask.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
